android.describe: Short answer: Room 3 does not manage connections the same way for every driver. general.title: Image Metadata Privacy Leaks: EXIF, GPS & Thumbnails
general.describe: A photo is two things: the pixels you chose to share, and a block of metadata you probably never looked at. The pixels are reviewed. The metadata is not, and it can carry the GPS position where the shot was taken, the exact device that took it, a timestamp with your timezone offset, your name from an editing app, and sometimes a small preview of the uncropped original. I build privacy and developer tools at PixelValut , and this is the leak I most often find in otherwise careful people's files. general.title: Building a Battery Management System (BMS) Core in Rust
general.describe: Every lithium-ion battery you use, from a phone to an EV, has a small piece of software and hardware babysitting it. That is the Battery Management System (BMS) . Without one, a pack can overcharge, overheat, or drift out of balance, and the failure modes range from a dead pack to a fire. In this post I'll cover what a BMS does and then build a minimal BMS core in Rust. What does a BMS actually do? general.describe: Why a virtualisation panel is worth the attacker's effort An attacker choosing targets weighs effort against payout. A server-side vulnerability in a virtualisation management platform is an unusually favourable trade: the entry point is one web interface, and the payout is every disk that platform controls. The FirstVDS incident, disclosed on 19 October 2026, is a worked example of that arithmetic.
